event.summary: Inkbox announced it was launching Inkbox: the identity and communication layer for AI agents.

sourcePreview.title: Today we're launching Inkbox: the identity and communication layer for AI agents.

evidence.title: Today we're launching Inkbox: the identity and communication layer for AI agents.
evidence.excerpt: Today we're launching Inkbox: the identity and communication layer for AI agents. We give agents their own email, phone, iMessage, and an internet address. Install @inkbox_ai identity with one command: allow anyone to reach your Claude Code, Codex, or Hermes from anywhere, and https://t.co/RlZGfXUflH
